description: This file defines functions and classes for handling nested tensors within the PyTorch framework, including creation, conversion, slicing, and masking of nested tensor structures. It appears to serve as an interface for nested tensor operations, integrating with PyTorch's serialization and internal modules.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Alias for nested tensor objects, imported or defined within the internal module, representing a nested tensor structure.

methods.name: Tensor as_nested_tensor( ts: Tensor | list[Tensor] | tuple[Tensor, ...], dtype: DType | None = None, device: Device | None = None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Constructs a nested tensor from a tensor or list/tuple of tensors, preserving autograd history.

methods.name: Tensor nested_tensor( tensor_list, *, dtype=None, layout=None, device=None, requires_grad=False, pin_memory=False, )
methods.description: Creates a nested tensor (without autograd) from a list of tensors with specified layout and device.

methods.name: Tensor narrow( tensor: Tensor, dim: int, start: int | Tensor, length: int | Tensor, layout=torch.strided, )
methods.description: Returns a narrowed view or copy of a nested tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: Tensor nested_tensor_from_jagged( values: Tensor, offsets: Tensor | None = None, lengths: Tensor | None = None, jagged_dim: int | None = None, min_seqlen: int | None = None, max_seqlen: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a jagged layout nested tensor from given values, offsets, and lengths.

methods.name: Tensor masked_select(tensor: Tensor, mask: Tensor)
methods.description: Creates a nested tensor from a tensor and a mask, where the mask specifies selected elements.
